features.name: Custom Agents
features.description: No-code capability allowing users to build agents in sandboxes without writing code by defining instructions, profile, and permissions. Available out of the box for quick prototyping and testing.
caveats: Some code may be required for advanced profile customization
Not suitable for shipping without proper instructions and testing

features.name: Sales Order Agent
features.description: Built-in agent for handling sales orders, shipped in Business Central. Used as reference for custom agent development tooling.

features.name: Payables Agent
features.description: Built-in agent for handling payables, shipped in Business Central alongside the sales order agent.

features.name: Agent Instructions
features.description: Natural language instructions that define what a custom agent should do. Instructions are wrapped in a larger system prompt by the platform. Recommendation is to write minimal instructions and use natural language.
caveats: Instructions are part of a larger prompt managed by the platform
Quality and specificity of instructions affect agent behavior unpredictably

features.name: Agent Profiles
features.description: Profiles limit the agent's UI to specific functionality and determine the starting role center. Profiles existed before AI and are used to restrict access and improve agent accuracy and stability.
caveats: Profile maintenance can be complex when new UI is added in releases
Code may be required for advanced customization

features.name: Profile UI Clearing Properties
features.description: Three new properties added to profiles that clear all actions, fields, and saved views from a page, creating a blank page from which specific elements can be added back through code.

features.name: Agent Security Handling
features.description: Platform protects against prompt injections and common security attacks. Agent interactions with UI are wrapped within Business Central and users are shielded from prompt changes.

features.name: UI-based profile configuration
features.description: Consideration to enable profile configuration through the UI instead of requiring code, with potential agentic help to generate pages.

features.name: Profile code support for extended properties
features.description: Code-based profiles support more property changes than UI-based approaches, enabling developers to modify more aspects of agent pages through code.

features.name: Configuration-based field extension for agents
features.description: Fields from third-party extensions can be exposed to agents through configuration without modifying the agent profile, allowing agents to work with custom fields added by extensions.
caveats: Only for fields not already in profile

features.name: Agent response to extension mandatory fields
features.description: When third-party extensions add mandatory fields, agents will attempt to set them and ask for user intervention if they cannot.

features.name: Item availability search page
features.description: A new page created for the sales order agent that allows users to quickly find items by name and check availability without navigating through multiple pages.
caveats: Part of sales order agent specifically

features.name: Smarter search platform support
features.description: Platform support added for smarter search on item pages that searches across all available items as the user types an item name.

features.name: Agent permission set intersection
features.description: Agents run with permissions that are the intersection of the user-assigned permission set and the agent's own permission set, limiting agent access to what the user can do.
caveats: Ensures agents cannot exceed user permissions

features.name: Indirect inherited permissions
features.description: Movement toward indirect inherited permissions that are controlled through attributes as code runs, granting permissions dynamically based on the flow being executed.

features.name: Model abstraction for partners
features.description: Microsoft controls model selection and updates, with the goal of making model changes transparent to partners so they focus on instructions rather than model specifics.
caveats: Partner notification required for model changes
Time provided to test before switch

features.name: Page-specific instruction syntax
features.description: Special syntax using curly braces and percentage symbols to include instructions that are only triggered when a specific page is open. Still plain text, not coding.

features.name: Timeline-reflective instructions structuring
features.description: Ability to structure agent instructions in a way that reflects the timeline so users can see instructions reflected as they review things in the timeline.

features.name: Custom agent creation wizard
features.description: Simple wizard in the sandbox that helps create custom agents by defining instructions, setting permissions and profile. Accessible from a plus icon or from the agents list.
caveats: Requires UI for writing and testing

features.name: Sales Validator sample agent
features.description: Sample agent that checks open sales orders to see if they are ready to release and then releases them. Available for partners and consultants to reference for understanding how to write instructions and profiles.

features.name: Sales return agent
features.description: Upcoming sample agent that processes sales returns by analyzing PDF documents, reading images, and creating credit memos. Can identify specific items to return and follow local laws and regulations.
caveats: Demonstrates variability handling with PDF analysis

features.name: Agentic scenarios guidance
features.description: Guidance on when to use agents versus writing AL code or using copilot. Good scenarios have variability, require different approaches, are ad-hoc tasks, or involve language processing and external knowledge.
caveats: Requires understanding of when agents are appropriate

features.name: PDF document and image analysis in agents
features.description: Platform capability to analyze attached PDF documents and read text from images, enabling agents to extract information and make decisions based on visual content without explicit coding.

features.name: Language model knowledge in agents
features.description: Agents can leverage large language model knowledge about languages, local laws, regional products, and terminology without requiring explicit coding or user lookup.
caveats: Knowledge may be general rather than domain-specific

features.name: Multi-language email processing
features.description: Sales order agent can receive emails in different languages, understand them, and reply in the user's language, combining Business Central data with external language understanding.

features.name: Low-frequency task automation with agents
features.description: Agents are effective for scenarios that run infrequently or ad-hoc, such as chasing payment reminders, with high reliability and low monthly cost (20-30 dollars per month).
caveats: Cost effective but requires careful design
Manual review step recommended before proceeding

features.name: Agent SDK
features.description: SDK being released that will allow partners to build and ship their own agents, including creating custom user experiences with review and setup flows.

features.name: Agent testing capability
features.description: Ability to test custom agents is being worked on and will be released soon, enabling advanced agent development beyond basic instruction writing.
features.status_evidence_quote: giving you the ability to test your agents which we will be releasing quite soon
caveats: Coming soon but timeline not specified
